description: This file is a TypeScript source code for importing Notion data into a board/archive structure, involving CSV parsing, file system operations, and creating board and card objects.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main asynchronous function that processes command-line arguments, reads CSV input, converts data into board and block structures, and saves the archive.

methods.name: getCsvFilePath
methods.description: Retrieves the CSV file path from a given input folder.

methods.name: getMarkdown
methods.description: Reads markdown content associated with a card title from the markdown folder.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Extracts column headers from the CSV input data.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts CSV input data into board and block objects, creating cards and properties.
